name: Pinillos (Colombia)
description: Light blue field with a green lower-fly corner separated by a white curved band, and a green disc at the upper hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Pinillos, a municipality in the department of Bolívar, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: curved band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
curved segment at the lower fly
